worldcombat.skill.sludgewave.summary: A thick sludge tide surges out from underfoot: foes it washes over are hurt, shoved back and may be poisoned, and the ground is left with sludge puddles. Surge style is slower and farther with a stronger shove; Slap style is one thicker, heavier wash.
worldcombat.skill.sludgewave.use.0: Wash a whole ring when surrounded
worldcombat.skill.sludgewave.use.2: Poison the foes pressed against you
worldcombat.skill.sludgewave.use.3: Soak a patch of ground and force a move
worldcombat.skill.sludgewave.description: Each foe the tide washes over takes about %1$s damage. The target's Sp. Def, type and crit are settled on the hit.
The sludge tide runs outward to %1$s blocks, sweeping the whole ring within %2$s s.
Those washed over have a %1$s poison chance and are shoved %2$s blocks away from the centre.
The ebb leaves %2$s sludge puddles on the surface for %1$s s, then the original blocks return.
worldcombat.skill.sludgewave.surge.on: Surge style on: ×1.25 radius and a stronger shove but a slower wash, at about ×0.85 damage, for sweeping a whole area.
worldcombat.skill.sludgewave.surge.off: Surge style off (Slap): about ×1.12 damage and the tightest, fastest wash, for soaking a group hard in one go.
worldcombat.skill.sludgewave.timing: Cast on the space within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.sludgewave.growth.0: At level %1$s the tide rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks wide, and the poison chance to %4$s.
On: a slower, farther tide that shoves harder, at about 24%% less damage, for sweeping a whole area. Off: one thicker, heavier wash with the tightest radius and a faster cast.
Beyond this distance the companion walks in instead of surging; higher opens earlier but lets foes step away first.
With this on, the companion raises Sludge Wave when another foe stands within 3.5 blocks of the target, so one wash catches the group; off keeps the normal attack order.
